```{r}

library(geosphere)
library(dplyr)


crime_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/phani/Desktop/AIT 580/crime_data.csv")


print("Structure of the dataset:")
str(crime_data)

print("\nSummary of the dataset:")
summary(crime_data)


print("\nMissing Values in Each Column:")
print(colSums(is.na(crime_data)))


print("\nFirst 5 rows of the dataset:")
print(head(crime_data))


numeric_columns <- sapply(crime_data, is.numeric)
print("\nSummary Statistics for Numeric Columns:")
print(summary(crime_data[, numeric_columns]))


categorical_columns <- sapply(crime_data, is.factor)
print("\nFrequency Counts for Categorical Columns:")
for (col in names(crime_data)[categorical_columns]) {
  print(paste("\nValue counts for", col, ":"))
  print(table(crime_data[[col]]))
}


landmarks <- data.frame(
  Landmark = c("White House", "Lincoln Memorial"),
  Latitude = c(38.8977, 38.8893),
  Longitude = c(-77.0365, -77.0502)
)

crime_data <- crime_data %>%
  mutate(
    WhiteHouse_Distance = distHaversine(
      cbind(LONGITUDE, LATITUDE), 
      c(-77.0365, 38.8977)
    ) / 1000,
    LincolnMemorial_Distance = distHaversine(
      cbind(LONGITUDE, LATITUDE), 
      c(-77.0502, 38.8893)
    ) / 1000 
  )

crime_data <- crime_data %>%
  mutate(
    Near_WhiteHouse = ifelse(WhiteHouse_Distance <= 1, "Within 1km", "Beyond 1km"),
    Near_LincolnMemorial = ifelse(LincolnMemorial_Distance <= 1, "Within 1km", "Beyond 1km")
  )

whitehouse_analysis <- crime_data %>%
  group_by(Near_WhiteHouse) %>%
  summarise(Crime_Count = n())

lincoln_analysis <- crime_data %>%
  group_by(Near_LincolnMemorial) %>%
  summarise(Crime_Count = n())


print("Crimes Near White House:")
print(whitehouse_analysis)

print("Crimes Near Lincoln Memorial:")
print(lincoln_analysis)

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(crime_data, aes(x = Near_WhiteHouse)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "cyan3") +
  ggtitle("Crimes Near the White House") +
  xlab("Proximity to White House") +
  ylab("Crime Count")

ggplot(crime_data, aes(x = Near_LincolnMemorial)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "darkolivegreen") +
  ggtitle("Crimes Near the Lincoln Memorial") +
  xlab("Proximity to Lincoln Memorial") +
  ylab("Crime Count")

```
